# Equality and ordering.

=== equal numbers
(= 1 1)
--- want
#t

=== unequal numbers
(= 1 2)
--- want
#f

=== equal variadic
(= 1 1 1)
--- want
#t

=== equal variadic fails
(= 1 1 2)
--- want
#f

=== equal needs two
(= 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message = expects at least 2 arguments

=== equal bools
(= #t #t)
--- want
#t

=== equal strings
(= "a" "a")
--- want
#t

=== unequal strings
(= "a" "b")
--- want
#f

=== equal lists deep
(= (list 1 (list 2)) (list 1 (list 2)))
--- want
#t

=== unequal lists
(= (list 1 2) (list 1 3))
--- want
#f

=== unequal list lengths
(= (list 1) (list 1 2))
--- want
#f

=== equal tuples
(= (tuple 1 2) (tuple 1 2))
--- want
#t

=== cross kind is an error
(= 1 "1")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected values of the same kind, got number and string

=== tuple vs list is an error
(= (tuple 1) (list 1))
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected values of the same kind, got tuple and list

=== not equal
(!= 1 2)
--- want
#t

=== not equal false
(!= 1 1)
--- want
#f

=== not equal cross kind is an error
(!= 1 "1")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected values of the same kind, got number and string

=== less
(< 1 2)
--- want
#t

=== less false
(< 2 1)
--- want
#f

=== less chained
(< 1 2 3)
--- want
#t

=== less chained fails
(< 1 3 2)
--- want
#f

=== less equal
(<= 1 1 2)
--- want
#t

=== greater
(> 2 1)
--- want
#t

=== greater equal
(>= 2 2)
--- want
#t

=== greater equal false
(>= 1 2)
--- want
#f

=== ordering needs numbers
(< "a" "b")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected number, got string

=== ordering needs two
(< 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message < expects at least 2 arguments
